description: Election Commission - Mr. S. Wasudewan of the Ganga Ihala Korale P/S has Vacated his Office of member of the P/S - Mrs. Warahenage C. Alwis of Ganga Ihala Korale P/S has Vacated her Office of member the P/S - Mrs. A. A. S. Wikcramarathna of the Ganga Ihala Korele P/S has Vacated her Office of member of the P/S - Mrs. R. M. S. U. Perera of the Ganga Ihala Korale P/S has Vacated her Office of member of the P/S.
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of the Ganga Ihala Korale Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, fitting the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including vacating of offices.
